Customer Success Lead
Company: Northwind Software
Location: Remote (Asia)
Salary: USD 1,800 to 2,400 per month

About the role
You'll own onboarding for new accounts, keep churn low, and work closely with our sales team.

Requirements
- 3+ years in customer support or customer success
- Experience with Zendesk and HubSpot
- Strong written communication in English
- Comfortable running onboarding calls with business customers
- Experience reducing churn

Nice to have
- Salesforce experience
- Japanese language skills

Benefits
- Flexible hours
